target: Catalog and bound the read-only Claude-facing surface over the task-orchestrator MCP: a callable-surface inventory classifying all 14 tools and 18 /dx: commands, an independent machine-readable manifest, and a read-only validator + test that enforce the read-surface boundary. invariants: No live task-orchestrator writes (manage_*, advance_item, claim_item, create_work_tree, complete_tree).

pr.title: feat(orch): task-orchestrator read-only callable-surface inventory + boundary enforcement
pr.body: First implementation packet of the DMX-ORCH-CLAUDE-SURFACE series (root 1b633d83). Catalogs the already-built /dx: surface rather than rebuilding it: a callable-surface inventory classifying all 14 v3 orchestrator tools and the 18 /dx: commands, an independent machine-readable manifest (.taskorchestrator/surface_manifest.json), and a read-only validator + pytest that enforce the read-surface boundary (a read command cannot gain a write tool). No new commands, no config/ADR edits, no live writes. Validator and test are runtime-read-only.

steps.task: Author the callable-surface inventory doc classifying all 14 tools and 18 /dx: commands, with the read-surface boundary and provenance/skew notes.
Author the independent machine-readable surface manifest (.taskorchestrator/surface_manifest.json) with per-tool classification and per-command surface_class + orchestrator_tools.
Implement the read-only validator and a pytest (with a bite test) that enforce command frontmatter against the manifest.
Produce the AGENTS.md §9 proof bundle with PAL chain artifacts and recorded validation exit codes.
